events.name: Sex Pistols
events.description: The legendary punk band, the Sex Pistols, featuring original members Steve Jones, Paul Cook, and Glen Matlock alongside guest vocalist Frank Carter—is performing at The Filmore after rescheduling their previously postponed 2025 tour. They will play through their classic album Never Mind the Bollocks, Here's the Sex Pistols.

events.name: 14th Annual Cine Latino Film Festival
events.description: The 14th Annual Cine Latino Film Festival returns to The Main Cinema, with five days and nights of film screenings, fiestas, flamenco dancing, food trucks, visiting filmmakers, family activities, and more!

events.name: 2026 Owámni Falling Water Festival
events.description: A celebration of Indigenous culture, music, food, art, and history in one of the Twin Cities' most culturally significant places, Father Hennepin Bluff Park. The festival honors the cultural and historical significance of Owámniyomni, the Dakota name for the falls, meaning "turbulent water."

events.name: Autumn Brew Review
events.description: Minnesota's oldest annual craft beer celebration, the Autumn Brew Review features unlimited samples of beer, cider, seltzer, THC beverages, and non-alcoholic options from over 60–80 local craft breweries and brewpubs, plus exclusive collaboration pours.

events.name: City of Lakes Art Fair
events.description: The City of Lakes Art Fair takes place in the beautiful backdrop of Bde Maka Ska during peak autumn colors. It will feature 150+ talented artists from across the state, live music, food and drinks, and more.
